$description: sendwire design tokens — W3C DTCG. SOURCE OF TRUTH. Authored 2026-07-21 from brand/reference/BRAND-BRIEF.md + RESEND-DESIGN.md (inspiration reference) + the live walk in brand/source/sendwire-com-screens/. LIGHT-FIRST derivation: Resend's signature is 'white is the loudest pixel' on true black; sendwire inverts the concept — ink is the loudest pixel on cool paper. Top-level group names map to Tailwind v4 theme namespaces (color → --color-*, spacing → --space-*, text → --text-*, tracking → --tracking-*, leading → --leading-*, radius → --radius-*, font → --font-*).

ink.$description: Primary text AND the loudest pixel: primary CTA fill on light. Blue-cool near-black (the cast Resend puts in its off-white ink, relocated to sendwire's dark end). Dark-mode canvas.

paper.$description: Light canvas — cool paper, faint blue cast. The light-first re-derivation of Resend's #fcfdff ink applied as a surface.

white.$description: Card/figure surface on light — one luminance step above paper (inverse of Resend's surface-card-over-canvas step).

deep-paper.$description: Inset wells: code windows, terminal shells on light. The light equivalent of Resend's surface-deep — depth via temperature, not shadow.

mist.$description: Hairline borders/dividers on light. Carries the role Resend gives translucent-white hairlines — the system has NO drop-shadow language.

slate.$description: Secondary text on light (captions, nav labels).

ash.$description: Tertiary/muted text, footer copy, disabled labels.

indigo.$description: SIGNATURE accent — wire indigo. Links, focus ring, selected states, chart-1. Deliberately not Resend blue (#3b9eff); sendwire's own identity hue. Never a solid section background.

indigo-deep.$description: Hover/active state of indigo surfaces. A state, not a second brand color.

indigo-wash.$description: Subtle indigo tint surface — chips, selected rows, atmospheric washes on light (glow → wash translation).

night.$description: DERIVED (dark mode synthesized — INTAKE 0.4): dark canvas = ink. Near-black with the brand's blue cast, not Resend's #000000.

night-raised.$description: DERIVED: dark card surface, one luminance step above night.

night-deep.$description: DERIVED: dark inset wells (code), cooler + darker than canvas.

line-night.$description: DERIVED: hairlines on dark ≈ rgba(250,251,253,0.10) over night, flattened to hex.

ramp.$description: Functional ramps — product-UI mechanics only (states, feedback semantics, charts). Indigo 600 is the brand anchor; neutral is cool blue-tinted by design (no warm grays). Per-step contrast referenced vs white.

yellow.$description: Warning / caution semantics. Amber-leaning so text steps clear AA on paper.

blue.$description: Informational semantics + chart series. NOT the signature (that is indigo).

indigo.$description: Brand + interactive ramp. Hover/active/focus/selected/tonal depth. 600 = signature indigo.

neutral.$description: Text, surfaces, borders. Cool blue-tinted (matches ink/paper cast — no warm grays).

font.$description: Three-lane stack (Resend's four lanes collapsed per INTAKE 0.5): editorial serif display, one UI/body sans, one mono. Fraunces stands in the Domaine Display role (open-source, variable optical size); Inter carries both marketing body and UI (ABC Favorit lane collapsed); JetBrains Mono deliberately ≠ Geist Mono.

display.$description: Hero + section headlines only. lineHeight 1.0, negative tracking — headlines pack into solid typographic blocks (reference principle preserved).

mono.$description: Code wells, inline code, delivery-log figures.

text.$description: Responsive scale (clamp). Ceilings from the reference ladder: hero 96 → clamps 44px mobile (reference responsive table).

display.$description: Hero headline, Fraunces. 96px ceiling / 44px floor — the reference's clamp ladder.
Structural to the brand — never loosen past 1.0 (reference principle).

tracking.$description: Em-based (PLAYBOOK #12). Reference px→em: display -0.96px/96px = -0.01em; Fraunces runs slightly looser than Domaine so display tightens to -0.015em; label +0.025em (button-sm +0.35px/14px).

spacing.$description: Kit-contract roles. xs–md follow the reference 4px base; lg/xl/xxl kept at kit page-scale (blocks were authored against them — PLAYBOOK #11: extend past brand cap rather than cramp). gutter/section/section-lg from reference rhythm (96/128) — FLAGGED for Gate A retune (INTAKE 0.7).

container-max.$description: Content cap (reference ≈1200; PLAYBOOK LEAK #5 — tokenized, container utility reads it).

radius.$description: Reference container vocabulary transfers: 8px buttons/inputs, 12px cards/wells, pills full. --radius = md drives every component default.

lg.$description: Feature cards, pricing tiers, code wells, email mockups.
